newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Egypt warns Israel of "destruction and terror".
newsitem.headline: Egypt warns Israel of "destruction and terror".

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak warned in an interview published on Thursday of "destruction and terror" if Israel mishandled Middle East peace moves.

"If the peace process is not conducted on the proper basis, I greatly fear negative results which will catch all of us and bring enormous damage. Disasters. Terror attacks. Suicide bombers," Mubarak told Israel's Yedioth Ahronoth newspaper.
"There will be much destruction and terror...and you will be responsible," he told the newspaper, Israel's largest.

Egypt and Arab states have been angered by new Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's refusal to trade occupied Arab lands for peace -- the bedrock principle behind five years of U.S.-backed Middle East peace efforts.
Egypt in 1979 became the first Arab state to sign a peace treaty with Israel.
